subject: principles-of-flight

visual_required_when: The explanation depends on a spatial or geometric relationship that is materially clearer when seen.

The concept depends on a graph, curve, force-vector relationship, control-surface movement, airflow/pressure distribution, instrument indication, aircraft attitude/path comparison, or component geometry.
A source-grounded visual would materially improve understanding for a student who answered incorrectly.
visual_not_required_when: The item is primarily a definition, symbol, unit, memorised value, simple verbal relationship, or straightforward calculation whose explanation is already clearer as text.
An image would be decorative rather than instructional.
A useful visual would add complexity without materially improving understanding of the exact answer relationship.
audit_rule.reuse_rule: A visual may cover multiple questions only when they test the same exact visual relationship; shared topic alone is insufficient.

snapshot.note: 232 includes 25 Batch 8 question-rows corrected from a stale REFINING status to LIVE_VERIFIED on 2026-09-14; those assets were already correct and already live, only the checkpoint was wrong.
